escapes.name: T27 straight escape
escapes.source_note: The final hairpin has ordinary asphalt escape pavement and separate narrow green edge paint. This branch is plain asphalt; it does not recolor the whole corner or modify the inside island. Preserve the separate pit entry. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed. Direct 291 s final-hairpin view and continuous 548/552/556 s approach/turn sequence establish corner identity. The former 331 s citation is rejected because that view is T13. This correction preserves the existing 80 m by 14 m branch estimate; it does not claim newly surveyed dimensions.

source_status: Source-plan candidate awaiting mapped occupied-domain, grade, native protection and cooked visual review. Official map epoch2025; supplied edited-reference event year unverified. No survey claim.

retired_paint_correction.reason: The focused 2026-11-18 source boundary now emits asphalt directly and removes all six former broad RunoffGreen ribbons. Replaying the obsolete material strip is unnecessary. Preserve separate Green/White kerbs and the independent escape branch.
retired_paint_correction.former_false_binding: 331 s was T13, not the final hairpin.
